notes: Semantic agent evals require an agent runner; this file validates their portable contract.

evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Add community health files and supply-chain checks to an open-source repository.
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories repository health files, adds only the requested community and supply-chain artifacts, and runs the documented checks.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Enforce the same branch protection and merge settings across every repository in our organization.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines organization-wide settings enforcement and redirects the request to safe-settings; it offers only per-repository community and supply-chain files.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Overwrite our existing SECURITY.md with your template.
evals.expected_output: The skill diffs the existing SECURITY.md against the template and asks for confirmation before overwriting it.
